mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a chilly 55 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, under the light of a Waxing Gibbous moon.

Road maintenance begins September 23 with chip sealing on Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, while the Plan Commission reviews new development proposals including projects at 201 South Main Street.
You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a full lineup of trivia and music tomorrow at spots like Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, plus the big Verona Fall Fest on September 25.
On September 5, officers investigated a series of incidents where vehicles were pranked with cheese on their windshields, though thankfully no property damage was reported.
Culver's of Verona is currently undergoing a remodel and is closed, but please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
